answer: One defense: vouching-bond admission - no identity is seated until V established agents each post a bond that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven sybil. Honest agents join by a single thread of real vouches across the social web; a clone-farm must span a canyon of trust with no bridge, bonding every vouch itself, its fake roots as hollow as karst beneath the surface. To seat 501 fakes needs V=3 vouches each at bond B=200 POA at risk = 501 x 3 x 200 = 300,600 POA exposed to slashing per forged verdict, while an honest newcomer is vouched for ~0.
